title: Chicken Parmesan (Quick)
description:
This is very quick to prepare and cook, and great with a little red-sauce pasta or a nice balsamic/lemon
vinaigrette salad.
The mayo-cheese mixture is also the basis of simple but very tasty cheese toast – just mix together the mayo and
cheese (maybe with some finely diced onion), spoon on some baguette slices and bake 5 minutes or so in a hot
oven, until golden brown.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Hellmann's® or Best Foods® Real Mayonnaise
4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (about 1-1/4 lbs.)
Or better, 8 trimmed and thin-cut chicken breasts
4+ tbsp. Italian seasoned dry bread crumbs (panko if you have it)
Maybe added some extra garlic salt and oregano
Tomato sauce that you’re using for the pasta
4-8 slices of mozzarella cheese, depending on the type (fresh, pre-sliced is better)
directions: Combine Hellmann's® or Best Foods® Real Mayonnaise with parmesan cheese in medium bowl. Arrange
chicken on baking sheet. Evenly top with Mayonnaise mixture, then sprinkle liberally with bread crumbs.
Bake on a greased, foil-lined pan until chicken is almost cooked, about 15 minutes.
Taken the pan out of the oven, dribble tomato sauce on each breast, layer on some mozzarella cheese
slices, maybe sprinkle on some shredded or chopped up fresh basil.
Return the pan to the oven for another 5 minutes or so, until the cheese is fully melted.
